// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_DECIDE_PERMISSION = "acceptance:decide";

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_MAX = 8;

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_PROVIDER_ID = "system.acceptance";

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_READ_MAX = 32;

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_READ_PERMISSION = "acceptance:read";

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_PERMISSION = "acceptance:report";

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_REQUIREMENT_MAX = 40;

export declare const ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW_SUBJECT_KINDS: readonly ["acceptance_subject", "acceptance_requirement", "acceptance_check"];

export interface AcceptanceCheck {
    kind: AcceptanceCheckKind;
    verdict: "supports" | "contradicts";
    tier: AcceptanceTier;
    gap: AcceptanceGap | null;
    requirement_version: number;
    checked_version: string;
    method: string;
    observed: string;
    evidence: AcceptanceEvidenceRef[];
    reported_at: string;
}

export type AcceptanceCheckKind = "engineering" | "hands_on";

export interface AcceptanceDecideRequest {
    subject: AcceptanceSubject;
    version: string;
    accepts: Array<{
        id: string;
        version: number;
    }>;
    returns: Array<{
        id: string;
        version: number;
        note: string;
    }>;
}

export type AcceptanceDecisionOrigin = "trusted_decision" | "goals_v5";

export interface AcceptanceDeliverRequest {
    subject: AcceptanceSubject;
    version: string;
    summary?: string;
    touches?: string[];
    made_in?: {
        run_id: string;
    };
}

export type AcceptanceEvidenceRef = {
    kind: "artifact_version";
    artifact_id: string;
    version: number;
} | {
    kind: "command_receipt";
    run_id: string;
    call_id: string;
};

export type AcceptanceGap = "evidence_missing" | "evidence_stale" | "wrong_object" | "evidence_unreadable" | "check_failed";

export interface AcceptanceHandoverSubject {
    subject: AcceptanceSubject;
    created_at: string;
    requirements: Array<{
        requirement_id: string;
        version: number;
        statement: string;
        expected: string | null;
        part: string | null;
        requires_person: boolean;
        withdrawn: boolean;
        position: number;
        by_person: boolean;
        actor_id: string;
        created_at: string;
    }>;
    deliveries: Array<{
        round: number;
        version: string;
        touches: string[] | null;
        actor_id: string;
        delivered_at: string;
    }>;
    checks: Array<{
        check_id: string;
        clock: number;
        requirement_id: string;
        requirement_version: number;
        round: number;
        verdict: "supports" | "contradicts";
        tier: AcceptanceTier;
        gap: AcceptanceGap | null;
        checked_version: string;
        method: string;
        observed: string;
        evidence: AcceptanceEvidenceRef[];
        reporter_session: string | null;
        actor_id: string;
        reported_at: string;
    }>;
    decisions: Array<{
        decision_id: string;
        clock: number;
        requirement_id: string;
        requirement_version: number;
        stands_round: number;
        version: string;
        decision: "accepted" | "returned";
        note: string | null;
        origin_ref: string;
        actor_id: string;
        decided_at: string;
    }>;
    satisfied: Record<string, boolean>;
}

export type AcceptanceHistoryEntry = {
    type: "requirement";
    at: string;
    requirement_version: number;
    statement: string;
    by_person: boolean;
} | {
    type: "delivery";
    at: string;
    version: string;
    round: number;
    touched: boolean;
} | ({
    type: "check";
    at: string;
} & AcceptanceCheck) | ({
    type: "decision";
    at: string;
} & AcceptancePersonDecision);

export interface AcceptancePersonDecision {
    decision_id: string;
    origin: AcceptanceDecisionOrigin;
    decision: "accepted" | "returned";
    note: string | null;
    requirement_version: number;
    version: string;
    actor_id: string;
    decided_at: string;
}

export interface AcceptanceReadRequest {
    subjects: AcceptanceSubject[];
}

export interface AcceptanceReadResult {
    views: AcceptanceView[];
}

export interface AcceptanceReportInput {
    requirement_id: string;
    verdict: "supports" | "contradicts";
    kind?: AcceptanceCheckKind;
    checked: {
        version: string;
        subject?: ActionSubject;
    };
    method: string;
    observed: string;
    evidence?: AcceptanceEvidenceRef[];
}

export interface AcceptanceReportRequest {
    subject: AcceptanceSubject;
    reports: AcceptanceReportInput[];
}

export interface AcceptanceRequirementInput {
    id: string;
    statement: string;
    expected?: string;
    part?: string;
    requires_person: boolean;
}

export interface AcceptanceRequirementState {
    id: string;
    version: number;
    statement: string;
    expected: string | null;
    part: string | null;
    requires_person: boolean;
    stands_on: string | null;
    carried: boolean;
    recheck: "returned" | "requirement_changed" | null;
    check: AcceptanceCheck | null;
    hands_on: AcceptanceCheck | null;
    verified: boolean;
    gap: AcceptanceGap | "self_only" | "contradicted" | null;
    person: "accepted" | "returned" | "pending" | "not_needed";
    decision: AcceptancePersonDecision | null;
    awaiting_voucher: boolean;
    satisfied: boolean;
    history: AcceptanceHistoryEntry[];
}

export interface AcceptanceReviewRequest {
    request_id: string;
    draft?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface AcceptanceSetRequest {
    subject: AcceptanceSubject;
    requirements: AcceptanceRequirementInput[];
}

export interface AcceptanceSubject {
    provider_id: string;
    subject: ActionSubject;
}

export type AcceptanceTier = Exclude<ReviewEvidence["tier"], "person_accepted">;

export interface AcceptanceView {
    subject: AcceptanceSubject;
    version: string | null;
    round: number;
    requirements: AcceptanceRequirementState[];
    counts: {
        total: number;
        verified: number;
        needs_person: number;
        accepted: number;
        satisfied: number;
    };
    complete: boolean;
    changes: {
        summary: string | null;
        touched: string[];
    } | null;
    review_reference?: ReviewReference<ReviewOwner>;
}

export declare const acceptanceActions: {
    set: ActionDefinition<AcceptanceSetRequest, AcceptanceView>;
    deliver: ActionDefinition<AcceptanceDeliverRequest, AcceptanceView>;
    report: ActionDefinition<AcceptanceReportRequest, AcceptanceView>;
    read: ActionDefinition<AcceptanceReadRequest, AcceptanceReadResult>;
    review: ActionDefinition<AcceptanceReviewRequest, object>;
    decide: ActionDefinition<AcceptanceDecideRequest, AcceptanceView>;
};

export declare const acceptanceErrors: import("platform/action-errors").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly scope: "invalid";
    readonly invalid: "invalid";
    readonly subject_unknown: "not_found";
    readonly requirement_unknown: "not_found";
    readonly requirements_fixed: "forbidden";
    readonly version_unknown: "conflict";
    readonly selection_changed: "conflict";
    readonly note_required: "invalid";
}>;

export declare function acceptanceRequestId(subject: AcceptanceSubject): string;

export declare function parseAcceptanceRequestId(requestId: string): AcceptanceSubject | null;
